{{Quote|Best post exchange around. You need it, we got it.|Oordu boasts about his stall|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Oordu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Quartermaster/Legends|ordnance officer]] in the [[Mantellian Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-allied [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]] during the [[Separatist War]], a conflict between the Central Authority and the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]. Oordu was posted on the outskirts of the Republic-held [[Fort Garnik]] on [[Avilatan]] island, where he operated a stall from which he sold weapons. While at his stall Oordu made use of a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] armor and white [[Clothing/Legends|pants]]. He had fair skin, red hair, and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oordu first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="TOR" />
